bootstrap_protocol.interpretation: Conditional descriptive intervals for fixed already-exposed predictions; selection/multiple-comparison uncertainty and dependence across weeks are not resolved.

limitations: All historical evaluation periods were previously exposed; raw configs and correction choices were chosen using development evidence.
Five rolling periods overlap and are not independent samples.
Weather slices use daylight rows with observed weather; full scoring and bootstrap retain observed nonzero night labels.
Tiny boundary-month fragments (including March1 midnight) are marked nonsubstantive and excluded from strongest-month summaries.
Negative relative W change means lower penalty; no official score is available.

supersedes.reason: Restrict improved/worsened month summary membership to strictly negative/positive deltas; all source statistics, intervals, and snapshots unchanged. Prior artifact preserved.
